risk_summary: The disclosure provides quantified deterioration, including a 29.6% gross profit decline, $12.4 million operating loss, $12.0 million net loss, and $8.7 million negative working capital. Liquidity appears pressured by factoring dependence, increased interest expense, tax and note payables, and a material impairment, although management asserts that going-concern risks are not material within one year. Extensive forward-looking disclaimers and reliance on potential financing and cash generation introduce uncertainty.
